messages:
marta (sec): Noticing KMS decrypt denies after RBAC rollout at 11:10 UTC. Regions affected: us-west-2 + eu-west-3. Sample error: `KMS:AccessDeniedException principal=svc-keystore@us-west-2`. Sidecar shows `tls: no cert available` during handshake.

leo (infra): investigating. The policy change trimmed keystore principals; looks like older rotator roles were dropped by the generator.

rotator-bot: cert-rotator(us-west-2): decrypt_fail count=5 last_error=AccessDenied backoff=35s

diego (sre): impact seems limited to new pod startups during rotation windows. Existing sessions unaffected. Recommend pause rotation + targeted IAM allow.

leo (infra): doing pause now: `kubectl -n infra set env deployment/cert-rotator ROTATION_ENABLED=false --regions=us-west-2,eu-west-3`. Also preparing a scoped IAM allow for `arn:aws:iam::444:role/legacy-rotator` scoped to those regions with 1hr expiry.

marta (sec): add audit rule to surface any Decrypt AccessDenied spikes after policy flips and create runbook step documenting pause rotation as a mitigation.

diego (sre): after pause, decrypt errors drop to near-zero and handshake failures decline. Will keep alert active for 24h.

leo (infra): root cause: policy-generator normalized role names and removed explicit legacy exceptions when tag parsing failed. Fix: update generator to preserve explicit exceptions and add a CI KMS decrypt smoke test prior to promotion. PR opened: https://git.internal/policy-gen/pulls/999

marta (sec): follow-ups: 1) merge fix + run CI smoke before global rollout, 2) add proxy PEM-cache fallback for one rotation window, 3) postmortem and update policy-gen PR template to require `kms-decrypt-smoke: done`.

diego (sre): assigning owners: leo (fix) and diego (monitor). Marking SEV-3 and drafting a short customer note if we see any regressions. :lock:
